statement: For either signed accelerated Collatz map, every positive odd unit root a has a genuine one-step predecessor m in each prescribed class modulo 3^r, with halving exponent at most 2*3^r. The same m satisfies q_r*C_d(m)<=C_(d+1)(a) at every depth, where q_r=3/2^(2*3^r)>0 and C is the complete all-source coefficient. Thus any coefficient-sum lower bound valid uniformly on that class transfers to all positive odd unit roots for the same finite depth set shifted by one, at cost q_r. For a fixed unit class with r>=1, coefficient-series divergence at every nonperiodic positive odd integer in that class is equivalent to divergence at all nonperiodic positive odd unit roots. No local or global lower-count or divergence premise is proved. No transfer between signs, Juggler pressure, termination or infinite escape follows.
